newsitem.title: UK: SOCCER-SHEARER FIRES NEWCASTLE TO THE TOP.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-SHEARER FIRES NEWCASTLE TO THE TOP.

text.p: England captain Alan Shearer fired Newcastle to the top of the English premier league with a 76th minute goal as they won 1-0 at Derby on Saturday.
Shearer's strike, following both goals for England in their 2-1 victory over Poland in Wednesday's World Cup qualifier at Wembley, put Newcastle one point clear of Arsenal.
Frenchman Arsene Wenger was given the perfect welcome as Arsenal manager when his new team beat struggling Blackburn 2-0 to move into second place. Ian Wright scored in the third and 51st minutes.

Liverpool, despite outplaying defending champions Manchester United for most of the morning televised match at Old Trafford, were beaten 1-0 and slipped to third. England's new midfielder David Beckham scored the first-half winner.
